purpose: Authorize exactly one corrective train-only native-mesh teacher distribution audit after V1 exposed a short-traversal indexing defect; no data, teacher, split, threshold or acceptance criterion changes.

approval.scope: One immutable corrective audit over the unchanged 80 training parents, 8039 edges, 16078 directed traversals, 188126 five-frame sequences and 252430 unique usable frames. Zero validation/C10/M-TARE reads, export, inference, training or optimizer steps.
approval.confirmation_reference: User granted continuous execution for the fixed GSE-Graph paper scope and asked not to repeat approval requests.

superseded_attempt.root_cause: edge_0022 is 1.515895119118246 m long. It correctly yields zero five-frame sequences and zero usable unique frames, but the V1 mesh inventory created two unreferenced single frames before comparing counts.
superseded_attempt.correction: Use the already frozen deduplicated_frame_arcs_and_sequence_indices contract directly; a traversal shorter than the four-metre history span contributes zero sequences and zero frames. No edge, traversal, sequence or world is deleted.

sampling.temporal_order: current frame plus four past frames on one directed traversal
sampling.short_traversal_rule: If traversal length is <=4 m, it has no complete five-frame causal sample and contributes zero stored frames; the traversal identity remains in the manifest.
sampling.trajectory_selection: all directed physical edges in both directions; no outcome or event-based selection

teacher.event_identity: TNG node degree/identity plus canonical physical-edge identity
teacher.width_height: sealed native-mesh route-frame left/right/up/down five-ray fan projected medians
teacher.turn: at least 15 degrees heading change across the frozen ten-metre spline span
teacher.geometry_transition: at least one metre sustained width or height change across adjacent five-metre medians
teacher.missing_geometry: mask width/height only; retain event and all other objective targets; no radius backfill

acceptance.paper_figure_bundle: PNG, vector PDF, CSV/JSON, generator, source run and SHA-256 manifest

failure_policy: Stop and seal on any input/tool drift, count mismatch, missing class, geometry-completeness failure, forbidden read, timeout or disk overrun. Do not delete the short edge, change history, thresholds or worlds, or reuse the failed run directory.
